title: styphelia javanica
intro: Styphelia javanica, commonly known as mountain pepper, is a plant species native to Australia and the Pacific Islands. It is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally employed in the treatment of various health issues. The health benefits of Styphelia javanica include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been associated with potential therapeutic actions such as wound healing and the management of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Styphelia javanica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
